## Overview

This project investigates the causal relationship between international gold price fluctuations and the incidence of social conflicts in mining districts of Madre de Dios, Peru.

### Methodology

Using a **Shift-Share IV** approach, we exploit exogenous variation in international prices combined with local mineral endowments to predict conflict probability.
